rows.grounds: absolutive expressing prior act of praise
qualifies the kinds or ways of praise
specifies diversity of the hymns or methods
demonstrative pointing to the verse to be recited

items.question: What acts of praise and recitation must follow the sprinkling rite?
premises: The officiant first performs praise using hymns of many kinds.
After praising, a specific verse is designated for recitation.
The sequence is prescribed to occur after the preceding ritual action.
items.inference: Following the sprinkling rite, the officiant should praise with various hymns and then recite this verse.
uncertainties: The identity of the verse referred to by amuṃ ślokaṃ is not specified within this verse.
items.plain_english: Having praised with hymns of many kinds, one should then recite this verse.
